skill.summary: Guide SaaS founders to build SEO from scratch focusing on keyword research, long-tail targeting, technical SEO, backlink building, and Google Search Console.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of SEO Fundamentals for SaaS Founders.

- Provides actionable guidelines for starting SEO from scratch, focusing on new SaaS domains.
- Covers essential topics: keyword research, targeting long-tail keywords, building domain authority through backlinks, and technical SEO setup.
- Includes a prioritized SEO timeline and checklist for quick reference.
- Highlights common SEO mistakes to avoid.
- Recommends using Google Search Console as the primary data source.
- Features a call-to-action to test landing pages with Racoonn's AI-simulated user testing.
